name: musket-offhand-items
description: D-155 (user 2026-11-22: 'only torches and shields should be able to go into the offhand'; 'test the aim button press, do real button'): with the Iron Musket lowered to the side a Shield goes into the left hand next to it and blocks; the REAL aim key (pressKey Mouse2, the default [Musket] Aim Key, read by the game like a player's mouse wheel click) raises the musket and takes the shield off, after which the musket blocks again. A Club is not an offhand item: it puts the musket away the game's own way.
